data.summary: Senior Back-End Developer and Project Team Lead with 4+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling enterprise web applications in PHP (Laravel) and C# (.NET Core, ASP.NET Core). Leads cross-functional teams through the full SDLC, from system architecture and REST API design to CI/CD and Microsoft Azure deployment. Builds AI-powered business tools with Claude Code, the OpenAI API, and the Model Context Protocol.
